0022600211.text: The Bucks (1-9, 0-4 on the road, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the Knicks (5-4, on a three-game winning streak and 5th in the East) in Milwaukee's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Tyler Herro (knee bruise, 21.4 points and 30.7 minutes per game this season) and Gary Trent Jr. (illness, 3.0 points and 6.3 minutes per game) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for Milwaukee, while New York's Josh Hart (ankle) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-2, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
